notes_sections.heading: October 18 run — complete (6 of 6 queries)
items: Run complete. Rendered in a real browser. DevOps Engineer: 13 results; Platform Engineer: 5; Site Reliability Engineer: zero; Cloud Engineer: 6; DevSecOps Engineer: zero; Forward Deployed Engineer: 1. WWR's search is loose keyword matching, so most hits are security, support or software roles.

Inside the 7-day window: PlanetScale Enterprise Support Engineer, Expel Senior Detection & Response Engineer, BeyondTrust Cloud Network Engineer, Abnormal Customer Solutions Engineer (EMEA), Current Senior Engineer (.NET), Lithic Senior SWE Product Platform, Lattice Senior SWE Infrastructure Platform (4d), Alloy Founding FDE. Five were opened in full (detail pages, real description confirmed). Expel, Abnormal and Current were set aside on title and category (detection/response, EMEA solutions, .NET application engineering) and not opened.

Best of the window: Lattice (score 4) — Ontario/BC-eligible at CAD $123.75–165k, but it asks for deep production AWS, hands-on Kubernetes and TypeScript. Nothing scored 5 or higher, so nothing was filed.
